problem_restatement: The continuous improvement digest exposed eight cumulative SP500 eligible decisions beside a repaired frozen-epoch lifecycle result with zero eligible entries. The two counters covered different source contracts and could be misread as missing lifecycle processing.

root_cause.mechanism: The observer status publishes whole-journal cumulative eligibility, while the repaired lifecycle hypothesis begins at decision_start_ms 1787103000000 after durable one-minute exit capture became source-complete.

implemented_correction.behavior: Preserve cumulative observer totals and add a separately labeled source-comparable decision epoch derived from an identity-validated append-only journal prefix.
fail_closed_checks: exact symbol, profile, and provider identity

hypothesis_decision.reason: The correction closes a measurement ambiguity but adds no source-comparable SP500 lifecycle or profitability evidence.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.action: Resolve the first source-comparable SP500 eligible lifecycle under the unchanged fresh15 v3 entry and v51 exit contract.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.why: SP500 is the closest missing roster asset, its source pipeline is now attributable, and a resolved lifecycle has higher information value than relaxing entry gates or transferring another strategy.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.minimum_diagnostic_evidence: One technically resolved lifecycle per configured side.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.minimum_change_evidence: A predeclared source-complete window with exact fees, funding, quote timing, stop and profit-lock behavior, positive after-cost results, and positive largest-winner sensitivity.
